blurb: Captain Bob's offers tritoon and pontoon boat rentals ideal for cruising, tubing, skiing, or relaxing on Lake of the Ozarks. They provide watersport equipment add-ons like tubes, skis, wakeboards, kneeboards, and floating Maui mats. The rental office is located in Osage Beach with easy pickup and drop-off options including vacation rentals, lakeside resorts, or docks.
extraNote: No hidden fees, clear pricing · Booking recommended early for holiday weekends and peak season · Rental office at 1233 Jeffries Road, Osage Beach, MO 65065, across from Dog Days
